lifecycle.scope: Exit resource release previously measured on the identical runtime with the pre-repair GLB; only skin accessor bytes changed.

limitations: Prototype art: close-up fur/hair surface noise, small armpit/hem stretch and knee shading artifacts remain; not a polished production character.
Run hem deformation diagnostic retains 9 edges over the stated 5 cm / 4x threshold at 0.6 s; these are local skirt folds, reviewed visually. Other seven clips have zero such edges.
Current game speed is 8 m/s; Run plays at 8/2.775, giving a fast cadence. No walk/run toggle was added.
Other species, animals, environment, spear and axe are still temporary assets.
Performance is a sample on this PC, not a guarantee for all devices; long-running memory soak testing was not performed.
